## Affected callers
- Type lookup calls `php_type_lookup_resolution_bounded`, which evaluates value expressions through the changed receiver evaluator (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:194`). The caller looks up the resulting FQN and constructs a type outcome (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_type/php.rs:31`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_type/php.rs:41`).
- `php_seed_assignment` evaluates assignment right operands through `php_expression_type_fqn` or its bounded counterpart, then passes the result to shared binding seeding (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:3247`). Those evaluators now accept subscript expressions (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:252`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2163`).
- `php_instance_receiver_owners` first calls the changed `php_instance_receiver_fqn` and wraps a single result in `PhpReceiverOwners::Nominal` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2746`); member-reference resolution passes those owners into `php_member_outcome` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:493`).
- Both usage scanners call the shared receiver evaluator whose callback and subscript branches changed (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1807`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1854`): targeted extraction supplies an enclosing owner by source range (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/extractor.rs:749`), while inverted scanning supplies it from its class-range index (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/inverted.rs:400`).
- Semantic diagnostics also call that shared evaluator (`crates/bifrost-php/src/diagnostics.rs:278`); `check_instance_member` passes its inferred owner and literal member name to `check_member` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/diagnostics.rs:502`). This route consumes the new callback and subscript typing (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1819`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1858`).

## Paths
- Supplying a resolution session sends `php_expression_type_fqn` directly to the bounded evaluator before its expression-kind dispatch (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:234`). The bounded callback route passes `session.scope_step` into the shared callback finder (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2133`), whereas the unbounded route supplies an always-true step callback (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2627`).
- The new callback finder uses `resolve_php_function_node` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:524`), which resolves through function aliases (`crates/bifrost-php/src/aliases.rs:565`). Its structured callable resolver produces namespace-primary/global-fallback candidates for unqualified names without aliases, and exact candidates otherwise (`crates/bifrost-php/src/aliases.rs:702`).
- Inverted scanning records references, walks children, and only then seeds an assignment (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/inverted.rs:153`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/inverted.rs:163`). Its assignment evaluator reaches the new subscript branch through `assignment_value_type_fq_name` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/inverted.rs:476`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:224`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1854`).
- For an instance call, inverted scanning uses the inferred receiver to select a declared callable and records that callable's FQN and member range (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/inverted.rs:300`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/inverted.rs:308`). This is a downstream route for the callback-element result produced at `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1819`.

## Value flow
- The bounded collection helper obtains `$this` field elements from `php_declared_field_element_type_fqn_bounded` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2072`). That producer tries indexed writes, declaration `@var`, promoted-property `@param`, then constructor-assigned parameter PHPDoc (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2539`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2558`).
- Namespace-shadow checks in the new bounded callback branch use `php_fqn_candidates` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2139`), whose lookup is restricted to `Language::Php` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/php.rs:2022`). The shared graph branch instead queries its supplied definition index (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1813`).
- The new callback helper finds the nearest local scope using the existing `is_local_scope` predicate (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:465`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:31`); it maps the matching callback parameter's index to collection argument `index + 1` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:544`).
- `collection_element_type_fq_name` dispatches variable collections to indexed-local inference (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1538`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1548`). That inference examines writes before the collection expression, skips nested local scopes, and returns an element type only when resolved element writes agree (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1400`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1421`).
- The new shared subscript branch stores the collection's element FQN under the subscript node ID (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1867`). Enclosing member-chain evaluation reads the dependency's ID from that map and uses its owner to obtain the next field or callable type (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1938`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1954`).
- The added `list<App\Source>` assertion exercises `parameter_element_type` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/phpdoc.rs:160`). Its existing parser selects the matching parameter tag, handles `Type::List`, and takes the generic element through `nominal_type`; two nominal union arms yield no single name (`crates/bifrost-php/src/phpdoc.rs:37`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/phpdoc.rs:89`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/phpdoc.rs:107`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/phpdoc.rs:125`).
